summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for any public beta or full launch; retain SearchWoot as private preview. Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution rights, while public terms restrict collection, derivative use, and commercial use of listings, descriptions, and prices. Human counsel is required for any rights interpretation or proposed affiliate/advertising use. No fleet-wide growth work is blocked by incomplete telemetry; preserve existing measurement-only work and create no duplicate queue work.

Launch-readiness progress: no legal task is closed because none has complete evidence. Source-rights evidence remains blocked; data-flow, consent/GA4, and logs/vendor/incident tasks remain evidence_needed. Next evidence action: attach an authoritative Woot permission or terms record, plus field-level rights and retention/display/alert limits, before reconsidering the private gate.

Fleet compliance disposition: ordinary growth may continue under existing approved measurement gates. Compliance baseline is 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; data quality is green for registry and SEO, yellow for analytics coverage, and red for revenue attribution. Do not claim site-level revenue, ROI, margin, or experiment payback until the unmatched affiliate tracking ID is mapped. Missing telemetry is unavailable evidence, not zero traffic.

Keep the private preview private. Public launch remains blocked pending source-rights evidence, human legal review, privacy and data-use evidence, and completion of technical, security, accuracy, and measurement gates.
Keep the private preview gated. Source rights, privacy, accuracy, security, attribution, and rollback evidence remain incomplete; no public beta or full launch is approved.
